newsitem.title: USA: Ensco says EPS could rise to $8.00 per share.
newsitem.headline: Ensco says EPS could rise to $8.00 per share.

text.p: Ensco International earnings per share could rise to $8.00 from an analysts forecast of $2.40 for 1997 if operating rates for offshore jackup rigs rise to $70,000 per day, allowing replacement capacity to be built, chief executive Carl Thorne said on Monday.
"While we are not projecting that this will happen, this is what would happen if day rates rose to replacement cost," Thorne told the Howard Weil energy conference in New Orleans.
Dayrates for the sort of rigs Ensco operates are currently in the region of $60,000.
Thorne said the lead time for construcion and shortage of shipbuilding yard capacity meant that only 20-30 new offshore rigs could be added to the global fleet over the next three to five years.
"With record levels of exploration and production and increasing demand for hydrocarbons, there is significant operating leverage in the rig industry left to be realised," Thorne said.
